other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual above 18 years of age.
Project must be a new enterprise; existing units with prior government subsidy are ineligible.
For projects costing > ₹10 lakh (manufacturing) or > ₹5 lakh (business/service), the applicant must have at least VIII standard education.
Beneficiary must not have previously availed any government subsidy under other schemes.
Priority is given to persons affected by natural disasters declared under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.
For up‑gradation loans, the unit must be profit‑making with good turnover, have completed a 3‑year lock‑in period, and the first loan must be fully repaid.
benefits_summary: Provides margin‑money subsidy (15–35% for new units, up to 25% for up‑gradation) and earmarks funds for backward/forward linkages activities such as training, workshops, and infrastructure support.
